description: Experiences are important, they develop us. #accountability #DesignYourLife #selfpresservation
transcript: Experiences are important, good, bad, and indifference. Experiences build structure. Experiences build curiosity. It builds solutions. It builds resilience. It is important to sit in the present moment no matter where the discomfort is and feel it. Understand it, accept it, and understand how temporary that moment is. But we have to allow ourselves to have experiences.
